utterances.speaker: Ben
utterances.text: Today we fly the prototype with the 1102s, 22000KV, and the Gemfan 1635.

utterances.speaker: Lea
utterances.text: It hovers cleanly, and the AIO controller stays cool.

utterances.speaker: Ben
utterances.text: The Gemfan 1635s fit the 1102s well. We will use them again.
